mapper.sql: select id, user_uuid, user_uid, provider, third_party_id, ip_address, country, region, city, user_agent, success, error_reason, metadata, created_at from auth.sign_in_logs

WITH login_with_rank AS ( select s.user_uuid, s.created_at, -- 按用户分组，按登录时间排序 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.user_uuid ORDER BY s.created_at) as rn from auth.sign_in_logs s ), login_with_duration AS ( select l1.user_uuid, l1.created_at as login_time, -- 下一次登录时间（作为本次登出时间） l2.created_at as logout_time, -- 计算本次登录时长（秒） EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (l2.created_at - l1.created_at)) as duration from login_with_rank l1 left join login_with_rank l2 on l1.user_uuid = l2.user_uuid and l1.rn = l2.rn - 1 -- 关联下一条记录 ) select 'App' as user_source, s.user_uuid as user_id, s.region, u.phone as phone, count(s.id) as sign_count, SUM(l.duration) as total_time, u.created_at as register_time from auth.sign_in_logs s left join login_with_duration l on s.user_uuid = l.user_uuid left join auth.users u on s.user_uuid = u.id group by s.user_uuid, s.region, u.phone, u.created_at;

WITH last_login_info AS ( SELECT s.third_party_id, afu.uid as user_uid, s.user_uuid as user_uuid, MAX(s.created_at) AS last_login_time FROM auth.sign_in_logs s LEFT JOIN auth.users u ON s.user_uuid = u.id LEFT JOIN public.af_user afu ON afu.uuid = s.user_uuid GROUP BY s.third_party_id, afu.uid,s.user_uuid ) SELECT lli.third_party_id AS third_part_id, afu.uid AS user_uid, ss.id AS lastSignId, afu.name AS third_part_login_name, lli.third_party_id AS third_part_identifier, lli.last_login_time, afu.name as nickname, u.role as gender, lli.user_uuid FROM last_login_info lli LEFT JOIN auth.sign_in_logs ss on ss.created_at = lli.last_login_time and ss.user_uuid = lli.user_uuid and ss.third_party_id = lli.third_party_id LEFT JOIN auth.users u ON lli.user_uuid = u.id LEFT JOIN public.af_user afu ON afu.uuid = lli.user_uuid GROUP BY lli.third_party_id, afu.name, u.role, afu.uid, ss.id, lli.last_login_time, lli.user_uuid;

third_part_identifier = null, where third_part_id = #{thirdPartId}
